title: Customer Service Advisor
company: People Solutions Group Limited - Agency - Permanent
description: Customer Service Advisor - Coleshill People Solutions are currently recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join our well-established client based in Coleshill. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy and established organisation in a varied customer service role involving telephone and email communication, order processing and stock ordering. Due to an upcoming project start date, we are particularly interested in candidates who are available immediately or able to start within the next two weeks. This role would suit candidates with previous experience as a Customer Service Administrator, Customer Support Advisor or Office Administrator. Rates of Pay: - £26,436.80 per annum (£12.71 per hour) - 40 paid hours per week Shift Pattern: - Monday to Friday - 8:30am - 4:30pm - No weekend working Benefits: Your benefits as a Customer Service Advisor are: - Monday to Friday working - Sociable daytime hours - Immediate start available - Full-time opportunity - Friendly and supportive working environment - Opportunity to join a large, established organisation Day-to-Day Duties: Your duties as a Customer Service Advisor are: - Handling incoming and outgoing customer telephone calls - Responding to customer enquiries via email - Processing customer orders accurately - Ordering stock and checking availability - Liaising with internal departments regarding orders and stock - Keeping customers updated on the progress of their orders - Updating customer and order information on internal systems - Resolving general customer queries efficiently and professionally - Completing general administration to support the customer service function - Delivering a high standard of customer service at all times Essential Skills: To be successful as a Customer Service Advisor, you will need: - Previous customer service experience, ideally involving telephone and email-based communication - A confident and professional telephone manner - Good written communication skills - Experience dealing with customer enquiries by telephone and email - Good IT and computer skills - Strong attention to detail - Good organisational skills - Ability to work effectively in a busy environment - A positive and customer-focused approach Please note: Due to the project start date, candidates must be available to start immediately or within a maximum of two weeks. Training: - Full training provided - Ongoing support from the management team - Opportunities to develop knowledge and skills within the role Apply: If you are interested in this role, please apply today and a member of our recruitment team will be in touch. People Solutions do not charge candidates any fees or request deposits at any stage of the recruitment process

title: Customer Service Administrator
description: As Customer Service Administrator you will joining a small, busy service team. The role is based on site in Buckingham, is full time and permanent offering a salary of up to 26,000. Working for a highly successful business who have worked in the garage equipment sector for decades. Purpose of the role: Supporting the service team providing high levels of customer service, maintaining the database and administration. Key Accountabilities of the Customer Service Administrator: - Be first point of contact for customers - Providing high levels of customer care over the phone and via email - Liaise with customers, resolving any queries quickly and efficiently - Generate system based quotes and invoices - Support with coordinating service administration - Contact customers to confirm proposed dates and obtain order numbers for scheduled work - Maintain database all customer records Skills Required for the Service Administrator: - Confident customer services skills - Methodical approach used to managing a busy workload - Administration experience within an office environment - Solid IT skills including MS Office - Excellent communications skills - Organised approach to work, able to work on multiple tasks at the same time - High levels of accuracy and attention to detail - Adaptable in a changing environment What's in it for you? - A salary of up to 26,000 - Monday to Thursday 8.30 am to 5.00 pm with an hour for lunch, Friday 8.30 - 4.30 with 30 min lunch - 22 days hol +bank hols, increasing with service - Training, support and development - Working for a successful, established business - Private healthcare for you and your family after six month probation

title: Customer Service
description: Are you a confident Customer Service Professional with excellent communication skills and a natural ability to engage with people? We are working with our client in High Wycombe, who is looking for a professional and personable individual to join their team for a 3-week temporary assignment this September. The role will involve speaking directly with franchisee owners, conducting satisfaction surveys and gathering valuable feedback about their experiences. You will need to be confident on the telephone, comfortable asking probing questions and able to accurately record and interpret the information you collect. Key Responsibilities - Conduct satisfaction surveys with franchisee owners over the telephone - Communicate confidently and professionally - Ask effective, relevant and probing questions to gather meaningful insights - Accurately record survey responses using Excel or similar spreadsheets - Review and interpret survey data to identify key themes and trends - Maintain accurate records and ensure information is handled professionally - Deliver an excellent customer experience throughout every interaction About You We are looking for someone who is: - A confident and articulate communicator with an excellent telephone manner - Naturally curious, with strong questioning and probing skills - Comfortable speaking to people at different levels and building rapport quickly - Proficient in Microsoft Excel or similar spreadsheet software - Comfortable working with data and identifying trends and key insights - Professional, organised and highly accurate - Previous experience in customer service, market research, surveys or telephone-based roles would be advantageous Why Apply? This is a fantastic short-term opportunity for a customer service professional who enjoys talking to people, asking the right questions and turning conversations into valuable insights. If you are available for a 3-week temporary assignment in September and have the communication skills and confidence required, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to be considered!

title: Helpdesk Administrator
description: A prospering service provider working with contracts for a number of major national and international brands are adding to their service team with an excellent communicator to work on the Helpdesk. The role will be responsible for managing the day-to-day flow of client requests for maintenance services. Your key responsibilities will be: - Answer incoming calls and respond to emails from clients and respond with internal resources - Log and manage client requests, prioritising them accurately and efficiently. - Provide updates to clients throughout the lifecycle of a job. - Manage work orders and statuses through client systems - Ensure field operation employees have the correct information to complete the jobs - Escalate potential SLA failures or delays to the appropriate manager. - Ensure jobs are correctly closed client reporting and invoicing. - Identify outstanding issues with delayed or incomplete jobs and escalate as appropriate - Assist with maintaining service levels for contractual KPIs and the department's administration Previous experience working within a Helpdesk or Service Desk would be a significant advantage for the role along with understanding workflows across different functions. The ability to manage multiple jobs and be able to prioritise effectively and maintain control of their workload during busy periods will be important, understanding the information being provided and what actions are required next. The successful candidate must be customer-focused, calm under pressure and able to maintain a professional approach when dealing with challenging situations.

title: Customer Service Advisor

Working as part of a busy customer service team, you'll provide accurate information, resolve queries efficiently and deliver an exceptional customer experience. Key Responsibilities - Manage multi-channel customer enquiries. - Resolve queries or escalate where required. - Maintain accurate records using Microsoft Dynamics. - Support customers with enquiries relating to their current account. - Meet service level agreements and quality standards. - Work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver excellent service. Apply today for an immediate start! Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. title: Service Coordinator
description: Are you an organised and proactive Scheduler, Planner or Coordinator who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We're recruiting for an experienced Scheduler to join a friendly and supportive operations team in Milton Keynes. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in coordinating a team of field-based engineers, ensuring customers receive an efficient and professional service. You'll be joining a collaborative team environment where no two days are the same, with the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis following successful completion of probation. Working Hours - 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm - Weekend cover on a rota basis - Hybrid working available (3 days office / 2 days home) after probation The Role As Scheduler, you'll be responsible for planning and coordinating engineer workloads, ensuring service and installation appointments are completed efficiently and within agreed service levels. Key duties include: - Scheduling reactive service calls and installation work - Managing engineer diaries across multiple locations - Working closely with Regional Operations Managers to maximise first-time fix rates - Coordinating follow-up visits and outstanding jobs - Monitoring service levels and aged calls - Providing accurate customer updates and estimated arrival times - Liaising with internal teams to ensure smooth day-to-day operations - Reviewing workloads and making scheduling adjustments where required About You We're looking for someone with previous scheduling, planning or workforce coordination experience who enjoys problem-solving and delivering excellent customer service. You'll have: - Previous experience within a scheduling, planning or coordination role - Strong organisational and multitasking skills - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal - Good geographical knowledge of the UK - The ability to prioritise workload in a fast-moving environment - A proactive and solutions-focused approach - Experience using SAP or similar scheduling/ERP systems - Strong attention to detail and accuracy Why Apply? - Hybrid working after probation - Friendly and supportive team environment - Stable and growing business - Varied and fast-paced role - Opportunity to develop your operational and scheduling skills Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job.
